items.text: For adolescents with long-term conditions moving from paediatric to adult care, what do readiness assessment tools measure, how well do their scores predict engagement and disease control after transfer, and how do young people and families experience being assessed?
items.population: Adolescents aged 12 to 19 with long-term conditions and their families
items.concept: Transition readiness assessment: constructs measured, predictive validity and experience of assessment
items.context: Paediatric to adult healthcare transition in hospital services

finer: Feasible in ten weeks of protected sessions; interesting to the steering group and to transition services generally; novel in joining measurement, prediction and experience; ethical as a review of published work; relevant to a revision decided in January 2027.
summary: One PCC question for the narrative review.
